body: [{"streamId":"01a1ae78-295f-755c-a1d0-713966cb565d","eventTypeName":"Hall9k.Domain.Features.Tasks.Events.TaskAdded","eventDataJson":"{\u0022Id\u0022:\u002201a1ae78-295f-755c-a1d0-713966cb565d\u0022,\u0022ProjectId\u0022:\u002201a1a29e-778a-7730-9f07-304d9ac0ffeb\u0022,\u0022Objective\u0022:\u0022RecordExportTests no longer fails intermittently with \\u0027The process cannot access the file ...coanda.db because it is being used by another process\\u0027, on macOS, Linux, or Windows, because no two handles in the export, the rebuild, or the tests open coanda.db in ways that refuse each other.\u0022,\u0022AcceptanceCriteria\u0022:[\u0022The cause is found and named in the pull request: which two opens of coanda.db conflict (a .NET FileStream with FileShare.None or a write share on one side, which .NET enforces on Unix through flock, is the first suspect; the test\\u0027s own read of the record to show it unchanged is the second), with the file and line of each.\u0022,\u0022Before the fix, the pull request shows the failure reproduced on this Mac by running RecordExportTests repeatedly (for example a loop of dotnet test --filter on that class, and at least one run with the full suite in parallel), and gives the command and how many runs it took. If it does not reproduce in 100 runs of the class, the pull request says so and fixes only what the code shows to be a conflicting pair of opens.\u0022,\u0022After the fix, RecordExportTests passes 100 consecutive runs of the class on this Mac, and the pull request gives the command and the result.\u0022,\u0022No test is skipped, retried, wrapped in a retry loop, or given a longer wait, and no existing assertion changes.\u0022,\u0022dotnet build --configuration Release succeeds with warnings as errors, and dotnet test --configuration Release --no-build passes on both CI legs.\u0022],\u0022Type\u0022:\u0022Bugfix\u0022,\u0022AgentContext\u0022:\u0022## Why\\n\\nOn 2026-11-05 at 20:26 the verification gate of task d6251767 (claims, which touches no export code) failed on this Mac with one failure of 2,114: RecordExportTests.A_rebuild_refuses_when_the_records_last_event_is_not_the_one_the_export_names_and_changes_nothing, System.IO.IOException \\u0027The process cannot access the file .../coanda-tests/\\u003Cid\\u003E/coanda.db because it is being used by another process\\u0027, thrown from SafeFileHandle.Open. The same message appeared earlier on the Windows CI leg in RecordExportTests (PR #69, main after #71); PR #74 (bc8dce2c) hardened daemon.json but could not reproduce the coanda.db case because it looked only on Windows. It reproduces on macOS, so it can be diagnosed locally.\\n\\nRead src/Coanda.Daemon/Store/RecordRebuild.cs, RecordExport.cs, RecordExportFile.cs, src/Coanda.Daemon/HomeLock.cs, src/Coanda.Daemon/OwnerOnly.cs (every FileStream open goes through it), and tests/Coanda.Tests/Daemon/RecordExportTests.cs and RecordHomes.cs. On Unix, .NET maps FileShare.None to an exclusive flock and other shares to a shared one, while SQLite uses fcntl locks, so the conflict is most likely between two .NET FileStream opens of coanda.db rather than with SQLite.\\n\\n## Non-goals\\n\\nNo change to the export file format, the rebuild\\u0027s behaviour, or the record\\u0027s schema.
